results.question: How do I check whether I've run out of file-table entries rather than out of storage space?
results.answer: Check /proc/sys/fs/file-nr, which shows the number of allocated file handles (open file descriptions) and free file handles. If the allocated value is close to or equal to the limit, it indicates running out of file-table entries [1] (specifically, the first number in /proc/sys/fs/file-nr). This distinguishes file-table exhaustion from storage space exhaustion, which would be indicated by df(1) output showing full block usage. [1]
